title: release_git_remote leaves its devbin-git.XXXXXX file under TMPDIR when a bound kills the call
body: k340's whole suite, run through `release gates` at 0eae6ab6 with TMPDIR set to a directory of its own, left two zero-byte devbin-git.XXXXXX files there, both at 11:38Z on 2026-11-12. They are release_git_remote's (lib/release.steps:849). Its own comment says a call killed at its bound (release_run_bounded) leaves its file under TMPDIR, since the rm after git never runs. Filed on vc's word, with no work now: nothing reads the file, and a leg's TMPDIR goes with its worktree, but a cut's local leg and every suite run leave such files in the user's TMPDIR.
